name: reasoning-workflow
description: Reusable reasoning and Deep Research with task-calibrated depth, problem-driven evidence, progressive context, and verified execution

interface.shortDescription: Understand first, research deliberately, verify proportionately
interface.longDescription: A reusable governing Skill for questions and projects. Task Admission selects Light, Standard, Deep, or Max depth and progressively routes six Skill Families. Deep Research follows uncertain premises, relationships, and causal chains to evidence needs. Runtime helpers support authorized execution, proposals, recovery, replay safety, and verification when invoked by the host. Controlled learning requires evaluation before canonical changes.
defaultPrompt: Use Reasoning Workflow and choose the right depth for this task
Research this question through its key premises and causal links
Execute this task within scope and verify the result
